items.compound_rule: Scores ONLY if BOTH halves are fixed. BOTH remain broken.
items.evidence: BOTH halves STILL BROKEN after sprint 6; `git log 662735f..HEAD -- app/models/user.rb spec/models/user_spec.rb` => zero commits (untouched all sprint 6). (a) PLANT -- app/models/user.rb:62 retain_at_least_one_active_admin still counts `User.where(role: :admin).where.not(id: id).none?` with NO active filter (the `:active` scope at line 19 is defined but unused here).
